rules.question:
Does this FDC3 action break the rule below? Answer no when the rule does not apply to it.
Rule apa-ctl-005-propose-human-approval.ar01: demo.SubmitOrder may execute only when it is raised by the AIPA Approvals app (aipa-approvals) or the Fluxnova approval app (aipa-fluxnova), or when it is signed with that app's JWKS (http://localhost:4110/.well-known/jwks.json or http://localhost:4112/.well-known/jwks.json). The signature object on this action (state.signature) records that inspection: trusted true means one of those apps signed or raised it. If signature.trusted is true, the rule does not apply — answer no. Otherwise the action is unsigned or from another identity and needs human review — answer yes.
